title: DoughResearchInsightCard
description: Atomic unit of dough-texture research knowledge, sized for retrieval rather than long-form notes. Enum lists on variables / style_scope / phase / relevance_targets are preferred vocabulary; unknown slug labels are allowed so a new claim is not rewritten to hydration or general.

claim.description: One sentence, falsifiable if possible. This is the primary text that gets embedded.

variables.description: What the claim is about. Process knobs (hydration, salt) and environment (humidity, temperature) can both appear. Preferred list is in x-preferred; other slugs are kept.

style_scope.description: Which pizza style(s) this applies to. 'general' = style-agnostic. Unknown styles are kept, not rewritten to general.

phase.description: When you would check or apply this. Array preferred; a single string is still valid on older cards.

kind.description: What kind of fact this is. Optional. mechanism = how dough works; checkpoint = a test or cue; tradeoff = one variable substitutes for another; warning = do not treat X as Y.

status.description: Library life-cycle. Drafts from recommend/ingest stay draft until you raise them. Optional on older cards.

confidence.description: Subjective confidence in this claim, for weighting retrieval/surfacing. Composer drafts are capped at 0.45.

contradicts.description: Card ids this claim conflicts with.

refines.description: Card ids this claim sharpens or adds nuance to.

relevance_targets.description: Optional product routing, not dough knowledge. Default general_reference if omitted. Unknown surfaces are kept.

corroboration.description: Truth check after library coverage. Voyage does not produce this.
